Discussed that families can differ in size and in who is part of them.
Identified family members in examples and compared family sizes.
Practised sharing household work among family members.
Trisha first said children are too small to help, then gave examples of helping with books, water, and tablets.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised different family sizes and family members with Trisha, then discussed why household work can be shared. Trisha mixed up the idea that children are too small to help; later they corrected this by naming ways they can help, including putting books away and bringing water. At home, invite Trisha to choose one small household task and talk about how different family members can share it.
